summary: A snapshot of the standardization status of Internet protocols as tracked by the IETF at the time. It served as a reference list of which protocols were at which maturity level. Its status is historic, and it was replaced by RFC 2800.

eli5.summary: It is a class report card listing how far along each Internet rule has come. A newer card has since replaced it.

questions: what is the internet official protocol standards list
where to find status of internet standards in 2000
